name: Data Patterns (India) Ltd
tagline: High-quality, vertically integrated defence electronics compounder (60% ROE, debt-free) with genuinely accelerating order inflow, but priced at ~94x P/E and still awaiting conversion of its largest optionality (Su-30 Hawk-I-2700 radar programme) -- a quality story, not a realistic 10x-in-2-3-years case at this size
business_overview: Data Patterns is a vertically integrated defence and aerospace electronics company (radars, avionics, electronic warfare, test & measurement systems) supplying DRDO, HAL, BEL and the armed forces directly. Key programs include LCA-Tejas avionics, BrahMos test equipment, and multiple radar platforms (including the Hawk-I-2700). Roughly 25-30% of revenue is recurring per community discussion, a differentiator versus peers.
fundamentals_table: Rs 25,812 Cr (Sep-2026, down slightly from Rs 27,040 Cr)

FY26 revenue +31% YoY to Rs925cr, EBITDA +35% YoY to Rs371cr (~40% margin); Q1FY27 revenue +16.8% YoY to Rs116cr but PAT -13.5% YoY on margin compression; FY27 guidance reaffirmed at 20-25% revenue growth, 35-40% EBITDA margin

FY26 order inflow Rs1,121cr (+216% YoY), FY26-end order book all-time high ~Rs2,062cr; Rs2,654cr (incl. negotiated) as of 30-Jul-2026; +Rs771.08cr further intake since, incl. a standalone Rs585.76cr BEL order (21-Aug-2026); management guides a further ~Rs2,000cr FY27 order inflow
Net debt-free; FY26 capex Rs100-125cr for infra/product development, funded from internal accruals; promoter holding 42.4%
fundamentals_narrative: Exceptional ROE (60%) and real, if lumpy, growth. The 2024-era community concern about a flat order book is now materially dated: FY26 order inflow was Rs1,121cr (+216% YoY), FY26 order book hit an all-time high (~Rs2,062cr), and by end-July 2026 the order book (incl. negotiated) stood at Rs2,654cr, followed by a further Rs771.08cr of intake including a standalone Rs585.76cr BEL radar-electronics order announced 21-Aug-2026. Q1FY27 itself was soft in isolation (revenue +16.8% YoY, PAT -13.5% YoY on EBITDA margin compression to 27.04% from 32.04%, on higher staff costs/timing), but management reaffirmed FY27 guidance of 20-25% revenue growth and 35-40% EBITDA margin, implying a strongly H2-weighted year. The Su-30MKI Hawk-I-2700 AESA radar opportunity (~Rs63,000cr overall Super Sukhoi budget) remains a real but unconverted catalyst -- physical hardware is built, flight-test software is being finalised, and the company itself frames roughly a further 6 months to full readiness as of mid-2026. At ~94x trailing P/E and ~14.9x P/B (Sep-2026), the stock already prices in a great deal of this.

global_signal_check.signal_hypothesis: record radar/EW order backlog + order-intake doubling + guidance raised + qualified-capacity scaling (the Hensoldt signal: H1-26 intake EUR2.81bn doubled YoY, backlog EUR10.36bn first >EUR10bn, BtB 2.4x, PCB output ~3x since Jan)
global_signal_check.india_datapoint: Q1FY27: revenue Rs116cr (+16.8% YoY), PAT Rs22cr (-13.5% YoY, EBITDA margin ~27% on higher employee cost + product mix); order book Rs2,654cr incl. negotiated backlog (as of Jul-2026), Q1 order inflow only ~Rs226cr (Rs44.9cr avionics MoD + Rs29.4cr radar DRDO); FY27 guidance reaffirmed at 20-25% revenue growth, 35-40% EBITDA margin, +Rs2,000cr expected order inflow in FY27; BrahMos seeker + SPJ jammer-pod catalysts flagged for H2-26. Peer Astra Microwave Q1FY27: record order book (incl. Rs2,205cr Uttam radar subsystems order from HAL, 'largest in company history'), FY27 revenue guide lifted to Rs1,350cr (+15-20%), but Q1 profitability soft on 'temporary delays'.
global_signal_check.note: Structural demand aligns - both Data Patterns and Astra Microwave carry record order books and lifted FY27 guides on the same radar/EW/indigenisation wave Hensoldt cited. But neither company's OWN Q1FY27 numbers show a Hensoldt-magnitude inflection: revenue up only mid-teens, earnings DOWN on margin compression / execution delays, and Data Patterns' in-quarter order inflow (~Rs226cr) was not a doubling. Demand is visible in the backlog and guidance, not yet in the reported quarter's growth or margins.

Score 2.5 -> thesis_fit set to 'neither' by explicit judgment given the market-cap scale a literal 10x would require (see verdict_reasoning), not via the growth exception.
